author: SpeakerJohnson
text:
If you want more money in your pockets, you have to keep Republicans in charge. We’ve DELIVERED — not just rhetoric, but a record.

If you put Democrats in charge, their goal is to grow big government, raise your taxes again, abolish the borders, abolish prisons, abolish national defense, and take away your freedom, opportunity, and security. 

It’s common sense vs. CRAZY!
